001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntIterator;
004import gnu.trove.list.array.TIntArrayList;
005import java.util.Arrays;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
013import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
014import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
015import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
016import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
017import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
018import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
019import org.clafer.collection.MutableBoolean;
020
021/**
022 * <p>
023 * Join a unary set relation with a binary function. This propagator is a
024 * specialized version of {@link PropJoinRelation}. The {@code take} variable is
025 * the unary relation and the {@code ref} variables are the function. The
026 * {@code to} variable is the result of the join.
027 * </p>
028 * <p>
029 * Here is how the binary function is encoded. Consider the function:
030 * {@code (0, 1), (1, 3), (2, 1)}. This is encoded as 3 different {@code ref}
031 * variables: {@code ref0={1}, ref1={3}, ref2={1}}.
032 * </p>
033 *
034 * @author jimmy
035 */
036public class PropJoinFunction extends Propagator<Variable> {
037
038    private final SetVar take;
039    private final ISetDeltaMonitor takeD;
040    private final IntVar[] refs;
041    private final IIntDeltaMonitor[] refsD;
042    private final SetVar to;
043    private final ISetDeltaMonitor toD;
044
045    public PropJoinFunction(SetVar take, IntVar[] refs, SetVar to) {
046        super(buildArray(take, to, refs), PropagatorPriority.QUADRATIC, true);
047        this.take = take;
048        this.takeD = take.monitorDelta(this);
049        this.refs = refs;
050        this.refsD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(refs, this);
051        this.to = to;
052        this.toD = to.monitorDelta(this);
053    }
054
055    private static Variable[] buildArray(SetVar take, SetVar to, IntVar[] refs) {
056        Variable[] array = new Variable[refs.length + 2];
057        array[0] = take;
058        array[1] = to;
059        System.arraycopy(refs, 0, array, 2, refs.length);
060        return array;
061    }
062
063    private boolean isTakeVar(int idx) {
064        return idx == 0;
065    }
066
067    private boolean isToVar(int idx) {
068        return idx == 1;
069    }
070
071    private boolean isRefVar(int idx) {
072        return idx >= 2;
073    }
074
075    private int getRefVarIndex(int idx) {
076        assert isRefVar(idx);
077        return idx - 2;
078    }
079
080//    @Override
081//    public boolean advise(int idxVarInProp, int mask) {
082//        if (isRefVar(idxVarInProp)) {
083//            return dontCare.contains(getRefVarIndex(idxVarInProp));
084//        }
085//        return super.advise(idxVarInProp, mask);
086//    }
087    @Override
088    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
089        if (isTakeVar(vIdx) || isToVar(vIdx)) {
090            return SetEventType.all();
091        }
092        assert isRefVar(vIdx);
093        return IntEventType.all();
094    }
095
096    private boolean findMate(int toEnv) throws ContradictionException {
097        boolean inKer = to.getLB().contains(toEnv);
098        int mate = -1;
099        ISetIterator iter = take.getUB().iterator();
100        while (iter.hasNext()) {
101            int j = iter.nextInt();
102            if (refs[j].contains(toEnv)) {
103                // Found a second mate.
104                if (mate != -1 || !inKer) {
105                    mate = -2;
106                    break;
107                }
108                mate = j;
109            }
110        }
111        if (mate == -1) {
112            // No mates.
113            to.remove(toEnv, this);
114        } else if (mate != -2 && inKer) {
115            // One mate.
116            take.force(mate, this);
117            return refs[mate].instantiateTo(toEnv, this);
118        }
119        return false;
120    }
121
122    private void findMates() throws ContradictionException {
123        ISetIterator iter = to.getUB().iterator();
124        while (iter.hasNext()) {
125            int i = iter.nextInt();
126            if (findMate(i)) {
127                findMates();
128                return;
129            }
130        }
131    }
132
133    @Override
134    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
135        // Prune take
136        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
137        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
138            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
139            if (i < 0 || i >= refs.length || !PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(refs[i], to)) {
140                take.remove(i, this);
141            }
142        }
143
144        // Pick to and prune refs
145        ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
146        while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
147            int i = takeKer.nextInt();
148            PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(refs[i], to, this);
149            if (refs[i].isInstantiated()) {
150                int value = refs[i].getValue();
151                to.force(value, this);
152            }
153        }
154
155        // Prune to
156        findMates();
157        takeD.startMonitoring();
158        PropUtil.startMonitoring(refsD);
159        toD.startMonitoring();
160    }
161
162    @Override
163    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
164        if (isTakeVar(idxVarInProp)) {
165            takeD.forEach(this::pruneToOnTakeEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
166            takeD.forEach(this::pickToAndPruneChildOnTakeKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
167        } else if (isToVar(idxVarInProp)) {
168            toD.forEach(this::pruneRefOnToEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
169            toD.forEach(this::pickTakeOnToKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
170            if (SetEventType.isEnvRemoval(mask)) {
171                TIntArrayList removed = null;
172                ISetIterator iter = take.getUB().iterator();
173                while (iter.hasNext()) {
174                    int i = iter.nextInt();
175                    if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(refs[i], to)) {
176                        take.remove(i, this);
177                        // Cannot call findMate here because we inside iterating take env.
178                        // Queue up the even to do later.
179                        if (removed == null) {
180                            removed = new TIntArrayList(1);
181                        }
182                        removed.add(i);
183                    }
184                }
185                if (removed != null) {
186                    TIntIterator it = removed.iterator();
187                    while (it.hasNext()) {
188                        IntVar ref = refs[it.next()];
189                        int ub = ref.getUB();
190                        for (int i = ref.getLB(); i <= ub; i = ref.nextValue(i)) {
191                            if (to.getUB().contains(i)) {
192                                if (findMate(i)) {
193                                    findMates();
194                                }
195                            }
196                        }
197                    }
198                }
199            }
200        } else {
201            assert isRefVar(idxVarInProp);
202            final int id = getRefVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
203            final IIntDeltaMonitor refD = refsD[id];
204            final MutableBoolean bool = new MutableBoolean();
205            IntProcedure pruneToOnRefRem = refRem -> {
206                if (bool.isClear()) {
207                    if (to.getUB().contains(refRem)) {
208                        if (findMate(refRem)) {
209                            bool.set();
210                            findMates();
211                        }
212                    }
213                }
214            };
215            refD.forEachRemVal(pruneToOnRefRem);
216            IntVar ref = refs[id];
217            if (IntEventType.isRemove(mask)) {
218                if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(ref, to)) {
219                    take.remove(id, this);
220                }
221            }
222            if (ref.isInstantiated()) {
223                if (take.getLB().contains(id)) {
224                    to.force(ref.getValue(), this);
225                }
226            }
227        }
228    }
229
230    private void pruneToOnTakeEnv(int takeEnv) throws ContradictionException {
231        assert !take.getUB().contains(takeEnv);
232
233        IntVar ref = refs[takeEnv];
234        int ub = ref.getUB();
235        for (int i = ref.getLB(); i <= ub; i = ref.nextValue(i)) {
236            if (to.getUB().contains(i)) {
237                if (findMate(i)) {
238                    findMates();
239                    return;
240                }
241            }
242        }
243    }
244
245    private void pickToAndPruneChildOnTakeKer(int takeKer) throws ContradictionException {
246        assert take.getLB().contains(takeKer);
247
248        IntVar ref = refs[takeKer];
249        PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(ref, to, this);
250        if (ref.isInstantiated()) {
251            to.force(ref.getValue(), this);
252        }
253    }
254
255    private void pruneRefOnToEnv(int toEnv) throws ContradictionException {
256        assert !to.getUB().contains(toEnv);
257
258        ISetIterator iter = take.getLB().iterator();
259        while (iter.hasNext()) {
260            int takeKer = iter.nextInt();
261            IntVar ref = refs[takeKer];
262            if (ref.removeValue(toEnv, this) && ref.isInstantiated()) {
263                to.force(ref.getValue(), this);
264            }
265        }
266    }
267
268    private void pickTakeOnToKer(int toVal) throws ContradictionException {
269        assert to.getLB().contains(toVal);
270        if (findMate(toVal)) {
271            findMates();
272        }
273    }
274
275    @Override
276    public ESat isEntailed() {
277        ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
278        while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
279            int i = takeKer.nextInt();
280            if (i < 0 || i >= refs.length || !PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(refs[i], to)) {
281                return ESat.FALSE;
282            }
283            if (refs[i].isInstantiated()) {
284                int value = refs[i].getValue();
285                if (!to.getUB().contains(value)) {
286                    return ESat.FALSE;
287                }
288            }
289        }
290        boolean completelyInstantiated = take.isInstantiated() && to.isInstantiated();
291        int count = 0;
292        IntVar[] taken = new IntVar[take.getUB().size()];
293        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
294        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
295            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
296            if (i >= 0 && i < refs.length) {
297                IntVar ref = refs[i];
298                completelyInstantiated = completelyInstantiated && ref.isInstantiated();
299                taken[count++] = ref;
300            }
301        }
302        if (count < taken.length) {
303            taken = Arrays.copyOf(taken, count);
304        }
305        ISetIterator toKer = to.getLB().iterator();
306        while (toKer.hasNext()) {
307            int i = toKer.nextInt();
308            if (!PropUtil.domsContain(taken, i)) {
309                return ESat.FALSE;
310            }
311        }
312        return completelyInstantiated ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
313    }
314
315    @Override
316    public String toString() {
317        return "joinFunction(" + take + ", " + Arrays.toString(refs) + ", " + to + ")";
318    }
319}
